hook: orphan 言語團進廣播室：circumlocution／blunt／cagey／discourse——主持人說「請直接回答」，嘉賓開始繞地球一圈。
script: circumlocution 繞彎。blunt 直言。cagey 守口如瓶。discourse 論述。drone 嗡嗡說。口令：麥克風寫「說清楚」，繞圈寫「地圖太貴」。

members.senseAnchor: the use of unnecessarily wordy and indirect language
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 繞圈麥: circumlocution walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「繞圈麥」出場：circumlocution 一上場梗就黏住——迂迴說法。

members.senseAnchor: make less intense; make numb or insensitive
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 直球麥: blunt walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「直球麥」出場：blunt 一上場梗就黏住——直言不諱的。

related.synonyms: numb, benumb, dull, deaden, candid, forthright

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 保密鍵: cagey walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「保密鍵」出場：cagey 一上場梗就黏住——守口如瓶的。

members.senseAnchor: extended verbal expression in speech or writing; an address of a religious nature (usually delivered during a church service)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 長講稿: discourse walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「長講稿」出場：discourse 一上場梗就黏住——論述談話。

related.synonyms: sermon, preaching, discussion, treatment, discuss, converse

members.senseAnchor: stingless male bee in a colony of social bees (especially honeybees) whose sole function is to mate with the queen; an unchanging intonation
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 嗡嗡聲: drone walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「嗡嗡聲」出場：drone 一上場梗就黏住——低沉嘮叨。

related.synonyms: monotone, droning, dawdler, laggard, lagger, trailer

members.senseAnchor: express ideas or feelings clearly in words
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 咬字清: articulate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「咬字清」出場：articulate 一上場梗就黏住——表達清晰的。

members.senseAnchor: a soft indistinct utterance; talk indistinctly; usually in a low voice
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 口罩音: mumble walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「口罩音」出場：mumble 一上場梗就黏住——含糊說。

members.senseAnchor: light teasing repartee; be silly or tease one another
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 玩笑球: banter walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「玩笑球」出場：banter 一上場梗就黏住——打趣。

related.synonyms: raillery, give-and-take, backchat, kid, chaff, jolly

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 地球儀: globe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「地球儀」出場：globe 一上場梗就黏住——地球儀。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。
